purpose: Teach: 風速/乗船/高熱/鼓動/洗顔/授乳/浄水/脊髄

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、台風時の風速観測史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered typhoon wind speed observation history in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Leans in slightly. Steady eye contact—the attention of a teacher who's actually read the work. Unhurried pace, like there's time for a real conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、近世の乗船記録の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I looked at early modern shipping records for my research.
lines.style: Respectful and focused. Speaks directly but not defensively. A slight hesitation before launching in, like he's checking whether she really wants the full answer. Quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高熱性疾患の歴史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And high-fever diseases in history—that was in your paper too, wasn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Not testing him. The tone of someone turning over ideas aloud. Slight tilt of the head, like she's genuinely working through something alongside him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、胎児の心臓鼓動研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I studied fetal cardiac rhythms as part of that research.
lines.style: Patient and clear. A small beat before answering, as if he's making sure each piece makes sense. Not rushed. Quiet confidence in the material, even if social delivery feels awkward to him.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: スキンケアの洗顔法研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Skincare cleansing methods—that came up in your work as well?
lines.style: Engaged but not pushy. A slight smile in the voice, like she's following a thread she finds genuinely interesting. Warm and present without being effusive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、新生児の授乳パターン研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I examined newborn feeding patterns and early nutrition.
lines.style: Steady, reliable. A small pause that shows he's thinking, not hesitating. Speaks with quiet precision. No performance—just the substance of what he studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害時の浄水器配備を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Water purification systems during disasters—you addressed that in your research, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. The pace slows slightly, like she's reflecting on the breadth of what he's covered. Genuine respect underneath, not condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、脊髄損傷リハビリ研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I focused on spinal cord injury rehabilitation methods.
lines.style: Calm and definitive. The tone of someone reaching a natural conclusion. Slight relief in the delivery, like the answer settles something. Still earnest, but with a sense of arrival.
